[size=150][b]Lionheart Fixt 0.10.1 - repairs[/b][/size]

One fix. The chests in the thieves' guild's secret stashes turned the whole guild hostile, on
three maps, on a hidden Sneak check -- no line of sight, no warning, no way to know it was the
chest. Now a thief shouts [i]"Thief!"[/i] when you're caught, a line tells you when you're not, both
go to the log, and the guild needs a living thief on the map to raise the alarm. That's what
every other stash in the game already did.

[b]Fixt[/b] is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run [i]Mod Manager.bat[/i]. Takes effect on a character who hasn't entered the
sewers yet.
